scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps backend packages tests scripts/*.ts *.ts *.json supabase/functions index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps backend packages tests scripts/*.ts *.ts *.json supabase/functions index.html
scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode pages && tsx scripts/finish-pages.ts
scripts.build:branch: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode branch && tsx scripts/finish-branch.ts
scripts.build:live-pages: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode live-pages && tsx scripts/finish-pages.ts --live
scripts.build:live-branch: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode live-branch && tsx scripts/finish-branch.ts --live
